bagPolicy.summary: Only small clutches, wristlets, or fanny packs no bigger than 6" x 9" and clear plastic bags no bigger than 12" x 6" x 12" are allowed. All bags are subject to search upon entry.
allowed: fanny packs no bigger than 6" x 9"
clear plastic bags no bigger than 12" x 6" x 12"
bagPolicy.note: Guests have the right to refuse a bag search and the venue has the right to refuse entry.

parking.note: General Parking is included in the ticket price, with an option to upgrade to Premier Parking for easier entry and exit. ADA parking is available on a first come, first serve basis.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Isleta Amphitheater's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Isleta Amphitheater offers a variety of food and drink options, including Mosh Burger's hormone-free beef burgers, Rebel Hen's crispy chicken tenders, and Ziggy's Magic Pizza Shop's NY-inspired pizzas. Guests can also enjoy Koko's Bavarian sausages and pretzels, as well as classic concessions like popcorn and nachos with a selection of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Isleta Amphitheater, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Isleta Amphitheater's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Isleta Amphitheater. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Isleta Amphitheater. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
